title: Implement a Dense Layer Forward Pass
description: Write a pure Python matrix-vector forward pass for a single dense layer with ReLU activation.
problemStatement: Implement a function `dense_layer_forward(inputs: list[float], weights: list[list[float]], biases: list[float]) -> list[float]` where `weights[i]` contains the incoming weights for neuron `i`. The function must compute the dot product for each neuron, add its bias, and apply ReLU activation (`max(0.0, val)`).
hints: Iterate over each neuron index i from 0 to len(weights) - 1.
Compute z = sum(w * x for w, x in zip(weights[i], inputs)) + biases[i].
expectedOutput: List of activated floats after passing through the dense layer.
